died.name: Jacques de Molay
died.desc: last Grand Master of the Knights Templar
died.cause: before being burned at the stake
died.last_words: Pope Clement, Chevalier Guillaume de Nogaret, King Philip! I summon you to the Tribunal of Heaven before the year is out!

died.name: Morgan Earp
died.cause: to his brother Wyatt; the brothers had each promised to describe to the other what he saw at the moment of death
died.last_words: I can't see a damned thing.

died.name: George I
died.last_words: Tomorrow, when I pay my formal visit to the dreadnought Goeben, it is the fact that a German battleship is to honor a Greek King here in Salonika that will fill me with happiness and contentment.

born.name: John C. Calhoun
born.desc: vice president of the United States
born.last_words: The South! The poor South! God knows what will become of her.

born.name: Grover Cleveland
born.last_words: I have tried so hard to do right.

born.name: Wilfred Owen
born.cause: to a soldier under his command before being killed in action during the crossing of the Sambre–Oise Canal in World War I
born.last_words: Well done. You are doing that very well, my boy.
